description: Includes 125 carefully selected reprinted cards (25 cards per color × 5 colors), allowing you to easily build a deck by combining just two colors. Also includes 8 packs of “Freedom Ascension [GD05]”, so you can customize your deck to your liking. Comes with Resource cards, Token cards, playsheet, half storage box (3 types *at random), and other accessories, plus a bonus pack featuring an exclusive EX Base lineup (3 types *at random), *All reprinted cards included in the Deck Build Box are standard, non-foil cards. Each bonus pack contains one EX Basecard with an exclusive illustration (3 types *at random).
